notes.title: Baby Mode Announcement
notes.notes:
Lately I've mentioned I'm working on a new [b]Endless Roll[/b] mode, planned to be release in February. If you've missed the news you can read more about it here:
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/33889449/announcements/detail/1693848448225676328 I've also mentioned a [b]Baby Mode Difficulty[/b] that will come along with the update, and I just wanted to shed more light on it.

[h1][b]What is Baby Mode?[/b][/h1]It is a difficulty level for those who generally enjoyed the concept of Dark Roll but found the overall experience too frustrating, unable to beat the early levels. It's meant for casual players who want to finish the game without breaking their keyboard / controller. I admit that Dark Roll is not an easy game. As of now only 2.5% of people who played the game have finished it. And that number speaks for itself.

[b]How does it make the game easier?[/b]
While the Baby Mode is turned on and the player falls off the map or dies any other way, they'll respawn like before, but all the gems they managed to touch will remain collected. Some levels will have checkpoints as well. However if you leave the level and comeback, or reset it, you'll have to start over.

[b]How will the player turn Baby Mode on?[/b]
There'll be a platform added in The Lobby of the game. Getting on it will switch between turning Baby Mode on and off. Additionally, there will be a notification in top right corner letting the player know that Baby Mode is on.

[b]Can I finish a level in Baby Mode then continue on normal difficulty?[/b]
No. The progress for Baby Mode is stored separately. However, levels unlocked on normal difficulty will also become unlocked on Baby Mode Difficulty.

[b]Are there any downsides of using Baby Mode?[/b]
Most achievements will not be available to be unlocked with Baby Mode on. All of the achievements with red icons will work with it on, as well as the achievements for finishing World I, II and III. But you'll have to play on normal difficulty to get the level specific achievements. There'll be also an achievement added for completing all 20 levels on normal difficulty, to reward those who didn't need Baby Mode to finish the game. Additionally, there'll be new unlockable content added to the game. Unlocking it will also require player to play on normal difficulty.

[b]When is Baby Mode coming to Dark Roll?[/b]
Sometime in February along with Endless Roll update.

notes.title: Endless Roll Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]I have some exciting news for you people! A big update is coming. For a while, I've been working on a new game mode for Dark Roll. It's called Endless Roll and it's innovative enough that I believe it would even work well as a game on its own. But that's not all I'm getting ready for you. So what will the near future bring for Dark Roll?[/b]

[h1][b]Endless Roll Mode[/b][/h1][b]What is it about?[/b]
Do you know this genre of endless runner games, that are popular on the mobile market nowadays? It's similar. Last as long as you can, get as far as possible. The road behind you crumbles... There's a huge fire portal before you and it moves forward... But get too close, and it will consume you. The longer you last, the faster you'll have to roll. The road will become more dangerous as well.

[b]Procedural Generation[/b]
The road you roll through is procedurally generated. It means that each time you start over, the path will be different.

[b]Steam Leaderboards[/b]
Your score will increase by 1 every second you last. Occasionally, you'll encounter gems. Collecting one will increase your score by 5. Alas, you'll have to assess the risk correctly, as it's sometimes really easy to fall off trying to get a gem. When you die, your score will be uploaded to Steam Leaderboards, so you can see how well you did compared to other people. Yay for competition!

[b]When is the update coming out?[/b]
I can't tell a specific date yet. But hopefully, sometime in February.

[b]Screenshots[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/6f80a3d75901751f27564829f7eaf0ca2771cc04.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/5c4bfa57b33c2c8832b81c013b2060ea8cccf15f.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/8fe3a25a5188c12e6b0abefb1e2662fcf504024b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/593fd77b2e5279fee788fcd77c593cba66e38ed9.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/6f375d4228cea97b2be2d3610610efddc018eea2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/c1893a830bb468279a03d30437e7df669e80fa0c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/dced2ffdc2ea7ff780f86aa8bcbe370e6ed1a299.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889449/0a7c9ab9e9e11c26207954ab48bf2bc6bff4659e.png[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Unlockable Skins[/b][/h1]Besides a completely new game mode, new skins are coming along with the update! However they won't be available from the start. You'll have to unlock them.

[h1][b]New Achievements[/b][/h1]With Endless Runner mode, there will be new achievements coming to the game.

[h1][b]Baby Game Difficulty[/b][/h1]Did you find Dark Roll enjoyable, but too difficult? There'll be a Baby Mode implemented. A difficulty setting, that makes the game a bit easier for the player. However, not all achievements will be available while Baby Mode is turned on.

What do you think about Endless Roll? Are you excited for what's coming? Leave a comment and let me know your honest opinion.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and the future of Dark Roll
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 is here:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Cloud support.[/b]
Your progress is now saved on Steam servers. If you want to play Dark Roll on another computer, your previous progress will be downloaded from the server. Just keep in mind that you have to run the game at least once after this update for your saves to be uploaded to Steam servers.
[/list]

I also have a question for you. Yes, you!

I do plan to release more content in future. I don't want to spill too much right now... But what I'm planning on is expanding the game in [b]new[/b], [b]various[/b], [b]fun[/b] and [b]exciting[/b] ways. And a thought went through my head - should new content be accompanied by new Steam achievements?

You may wonder "Why would this be any kind of a problem for anyone?". See, some people on here are true achievement hunters. And once you get 100% achievements in a game, it may seem unfair for new achievements to be released.

[b]I want to know your opinion so I made this anonymous questionnaire. Please spare 5 seconds of your precious time to answer, I'll appreciate it!

https://forms.gle/BQLBL3tViWP1qjKM7[/b]

If you want to report a bug, please e-mail:
artbariangames@gmail.com

Please like my Facebook page if you haven't yet. You don't want to miss any important updates in future, do you?
www.fb.com/artbariangames

[b]Also, leave a review on Steam if you didn't yet.[/b] Your opinion truly matters, and I'd like to know what was done right and what could have been done differently.
